mapper.select: SELECT o.domestic_product_id, dp.sector_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN ABS(o.amount) - o.fee_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buy_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sell_count FROM domestic_order o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = o.domestic_product_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' GROUP BY o.domestic_product_id, dp.sector_name ORDER BY o.domestic_product_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, MIN(o.processed_at) AS first_processed_at FROM domestic_order o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.status = 'EXECUTED'
